changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Prevent a workflow actor from recording the same terminal decision more than once for one workflow step.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workflow_action_terminal_actor ON "${schema}".workflow_action (tenant_id, instance_id, workflow_step_id, performed_by, action) WHERE action IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT');

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Store the exact effective permission required by workflow steps; roles remain assignment containers only.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE "${schema}".workflow_step AS workflow_step SET approver_permission = CASE UPPER(TRIM(workflow.entity_type)) WHEN 'LEAVE_REQUEST' THEN 'leave:approve' WHEN 'EXPENSE' THEN 'expense:approve' WHEN 'TRAVEL_REQUEST' THEN 'expense:approve' WHEN 'TIMESHEET_WEEK_BATCH' THEN 'timesheet:approve' ELSE workflow_step.approver_permission END, approver_type = CASE UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(workflow_step.approver_type, 'REPORTING_MANAGER'))) WHEN 'ROLE' THEN 'PERMISSION' WHEN 'REPORTING_MANAGER_OR_ROLE' THEN 'REPORTING_MANAGER_OR_PERMISSION' WHEN 'MANAGER_OR_ROLE' THEN 'REPORTING_MANAGER_OR_PERMISSION' ELSE workflow_step.approver_type END, approver_role_id = CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(workflow_step.approver_type, 'REPORTING_MANAGER'))) IN ('ROLE', 'REPORTING_MANAGER_OR_ROLE', 'MANAGER_OR_ROLE') THEN NULL ELSE workflow_step.approver_role_id END, updated_at = NOW() FROM "${schema}".workflow AS workflow WHERE workflow.id = workflow_step.workflow_id AND workflow.tenant_id = workflow_step.tenant_id AND UPPER(TRIM(workflow.entity_type)) IN ('LEAVE_REQUEST', 'EXPENSE', 'TRAVEL_REQUEST', 'TIMESHEET_WEEK_BATCH');
ALTER TABLE "${schema}".workflow_step ADD CONSTRAINT ck_workflow_step_permission_authority CHECK ( UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(approver_type, 'REPORTING_MANAGER'))) NOT IN ('PERMISSION', 'REPORTING_MANAGER_OR_PERMISSION', 'MANAGER_OR_PERMISSION') OR NULLIF(TRIM(approver_permission), '') IS NOT NULL );

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".workflow_step DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_workflow_step_permission_authority;
